style.backgroundSystem: hard-edged overlapping flat colour blocks stacked like layered paper: page stock #FFFFFF, periwinkle block #A9BCF0, pale mint panel #E6F2E8, butter-yellow banner #F6CE79, deep slate-blue cards #4C5F86, with thin outlined rectangular picture frames carrying offset drop shadows; the only ornament is small wavy-line doodles, solid dots and one diagonal slash mark
style.direction: pastel color-block womens apparel detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line glyphs centred inside solid white circles, one glyph per benefit, plus butter-yellow rounded section banners with two short side dashes and one small dot; circular photo insets ringed with a thin outline; no filled 3D icons, no seals, no authority badges
style.lightingSystem: soft even 5600-5700K studio daylight, key from the upper left, gentle wrap fill on the shadow side, low-contrast soft contact shadows only, no hard flash, no mixed colour casts, identical key direction inside every panel of one layout
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent pastel color-block apparel detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean page stock #FFFFFF, periwinkle block #A9BCF0, pale mint panel #E6F2E8, butter-yellow banner #F6CE79, deep slate-blue card #4C5F86 and ink type #2E3A5C, plus one accent color matched to the product supplied as {accent_color} at generation time; neutral reading with warm pastel support; one modern geometric sans-serif family for Chinese and Latin, bold Chinese headline over a thin ruled underline with a small letter-spaced English kicker, all rendered Chinese copy wrapped in 「」, headline 28-40pt, subhead 18-20pt, labels 12-16pt, no dense body text; background system of hard-edged overlapping flat colour blocks stacked like layered paper with thin outlined rectangular picture frames and offset drop shadows, ornamented only by small wavy-line doodles, solid dots and one diagonal slash mark; lighting system of soft even 5600-5700K studio daylight, key from the upper left, gentle wrap fill, low-contrast soft contact shadows only, no hard flash, no mixed colour casts; layout system of generous margins, rounded-rectangle cards, butter-yellow rounded section banners with two short side dashes and one small dot, circular photo insets ringed with a thin outline, and tidy bordered tables with an accent-filled header row and open value rows; icon system of thin single-weight line glyphs centred inside solid white circles, no filled 3D icons, no seals or authority badges; product presentation rules: one generic unidentifiable model with the head cropped above the chin or turned away, or the garment laid flat, neckline, waist definition and hemline kept readable in every panel, consistent front 3/4 read across scenes, stable scale and centring, relaxed fully formed hands never covering the garment; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched banner or icon styles, no identifiable faces, no brand marks, no watermarks, no QR codes.
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting direction or colour temperature
no mismatched banner, icon or inset-ring styles
no identifiable model faces or source likeness
no brand marks, watermarks or QR codes
no product-specific wording that assumes one garment type
style.presentationRules: the garment is worn by one generic unidentifiable model with the head cropped above the chin or turned away, or laid flat; the neckline, waist definition and hemline stay readable in every panel; the front 3/4 read stays consistent across scenes so the item reads as the same object; stable scale and centring; hands relaxed with fully formed fingers and never covering the garment
style.surfaceSystem: clean matte paper card stock for infographic screens; painted pastel wall and step for scenes; the garment's own woven face as the surface for macro; garment laid flat and squared for overhead spec screens
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for Chinese and Latin; bold Chinese headline over a thin ruled underline, English kicker set small and letter-spaced; all rendered Chinese copy wrapped in 「」; headline 28-40pt, subhead 18-20pt, labels 12-16pt; no dense body text, no serif, handwritten, retro or cartoon faces
